parameters.text:
👋 *Welcome to StockSense Inventory Assistant!*

I'm connected to your shop's billing dashboard and database.

🛒 *What I can do:*
• *Add New Stock:* Snap a photo of any product, type the quantity (and optionally price) in the caption, and send it. Vision AI will identify the item and update your inventory automatically.
• *Low Stock Alerts:* I'll ping you here when items drop below safe threshold at the billing counter.

📝 *Caption Format:*
`20` → adds 20 units (AI guesses price)
`20 10rs` → adds 20 units at ₹10 each
`15 for 45rs` → adds 15 units at ₹45 each

Ready? Send a product photo to begin! 🚀
